name: Braxis Holdout
theme: Capture and hold the beacons to power up the Zerg swarm and unleash a devastating wave against the enemy.
firstObjective: Warning at 1:45, spawns at 2:15 (~1:45 cooldown after waves finish)
spawnPattern: Two beacons always activate simultaneously (Top & Bottom lanes)

mechanic.title: Beacon Control & Zerg Swarm
mechanic.description: Capturing and holding the Top and Bottom beacons charges your team's Zerg wave meter up to 100%, with faster fill rates when holding both points. Once a team reaches 100% or the objective phase ends, a Zerg wave scaled to each team's charge—composed of Zerglings, Banelings, Guardians, and Ultralisks—launches down both lanes to siege enemy structures.

camps.name: Goliath / Medic Camp (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the side lanes/alcoves. Pairs a ranged Goliath with a Healing Medic that keeps lane minions and mercs sustained during pushes.

camps.name: Razorgill / Bruiser Camp (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Heavy melee Razorgill bruisers with armor/damage traits that apply steady lane pressure and punish unguarded lanes.

strategy: Braxis Holdout is a two-lane map where solo-lane beacon control and 4-man rotation timing heavily swing Zerg wave percentages. Strong solo laners (such as Rexxar, Malthael, or Sonya) help hold or contest a beacon independently while the 4-man rotates, trades, or captures camps right before beacons activate so lane pressure supports your push.
notes: Because there are only two lanes and no Boss camp, losing a beacon phase with a high Zerg percentage can snowball structures quickly—defending big Zerg waves efficiently with AoE waveclear and focusing Guardians/Ultralisks/Banelings is critical when behind on objective charge.
